### Zevia to Participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference


November 10, 2026


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Zevia PBC (“Zevia”) (NYSE:ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today announced that Alexandre Ruberti, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Girish Satya, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee.


Management will meet with investors and participate in a presentation on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at approximately 9:30 am CT. A live webcast of the presentation will be available on the Investor Relations section of Zevia’s website at[https://investors.zevia.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54638179&newsitemid=20261110569313&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&index=1&md5=ffb0cfe5c8893e2dfbdb1efb24189cbe) during the event. Shortly following the event, a replay will be available at[https://investors.zevia.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&esheet=54638179&newsitemid=20261110569313&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&index=2&md5=00e99fb9b2473175502a997c38ad0eff) for thirty (30) days.


**About Zevia**


Zevia PBC is a Delaware public benefit corporation and Certified B Corporation offering a portfolio of naturally sweetened, better-for-you beverages made with simple, plant-based ingredients. Zevia® products are Non-GMO Project Verified, gluten-free, and vegan, and are distributed in more than 41,500 retail locations in the U.S. and Canada through a diverse network of major retailers in the grocery, drug, warehouse club, mass, natural, convenience and ecommerce channels.
